paragraphs.text: Beau is an ox from an unknown plane who arrived on Thunder Junction after the Omenpaths opened.

Beau is a character that was introduced on a token in Outlaws of Thunder Junction . Like their giant companion Bonny Pall , it is massive, towering over the trees it eats. Beau also has blue and white hair covering its body. Its token gains power and toughness equal to the number of lands the player controls.
